data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Cannell Capital LLC’s most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in GBLI, SHIM, and SJT.

On September 18, 2026, SJT filed an earnings release under 8-K Item 2.02, Exhibit 99.1 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/319655/000119312526395495/sjt-ex99_1.htm).

I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot.

Best,
Andrew

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
